description: `flags` containing `|` and `;` must fail: unlike `filter_complex` (the companion `c-ffmpeg-filter-complex-allows-pipe-and-semicolon` case, where ffmpeg's own filter-graph separators are allowed), `flags` goes through the stricter shell-metacharacter check, which rejects both. `|` wins over `;` here: the checker scans its metacharacter tuple in tuple order, and `|` comes first.
